Class GameUI

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.GameUI
Direct Known Subclasses:
GUI, TUI
public abstract class GameUI extends Object
Abstract base for UI implementations (TUI and GUI). Converts incoming ServerResponse callbacks (called by AppCoordinator) into ServerEvent objects and dispatches them to the active screen via dispatch(ServerEvent).

Concrete subclasses (TUI, GUI) implement dispatch(ServerEvent), start(), and shutdown() for their respective rendering technology.
